summary: A governance framework for building trustworthy agentic AI for public sector and regulated organizations. Covers governance controls across four implementation areas: foundational monitoring, access control, operational boundaries, and advanced automation oversight.

risk_tiers.description: AI agents with significant autonomous decision-making capability, multi-step planning, and ability to take consequential actions without human approval.
criteria: Agent can execute multi-step workflows autonomously
Agent has access to production systems or sensitive data
Agent actions are difficult to reverse
Agent operates in regulated or safety-critical domains
Agent can interact with external systems or APIs

risk_tiers.description: AI agents that operate with human-in-the-loop oversight, requiring approval for consequential actions while handling routine tasks autonomously.
criteria: Agent requires human approval for high-impact actions
Agent operates within defined operational boundaries
Agent actions are logged and auditable
Human can intervene and override at any point

risk_tiers.description: AI agents with strictly limited capabilities, operating within narrow task boundaries with full human control.

key_obligations.obligation: Implement foundational monitoring with comprehensive logging of all agent actions, decisions, and state changes for auditability
Establish granular access controls using IAM policies to restrict agent permissions to minimum required scope with time-bound credentials
Define operational boundaries and guardrails that constrain agent behavior including action limits, resource quotas, and escalation triggers
Implement automated governance checks including pre-action validation, post-action verification, and continuous compliance monitoring
Design human escalation paths for high-risk decisions with defined SLAs and clear handoff procedures between agent and human operators

data_residency_requirements: Supports GovCloud for US government workloads
enforcement_timeline: Voluntary framework published May 2026. Designed to complement existing regulations (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF) for agentic AI workloads.
recent_changes: Initial publication May 26, 2026 focused on public sector and regulated organizations
Four-tier implementation model from monitoring to advanced automation
Integration patterns with AWS CloudTrail, IAM, and Bedrock Guardrails
